title: i18n Completeness
description: User-visible strings must go through `t()` so TR/EN toggle works everywhere.

rules.message: Multi-word capitalized text directly in JSX — likely a hardcoded English string.
rules.remediation: Replace with `{t('namespace.key')}` and add the key to src/i18n/translations.ts in both EN and TR.

rules.message: Multi-word Turkish text directly in JSX — must go through t().
Button label is a literal string, not via t() — language toggle leaves it stuck in source language.
rules.remediation: Wrap with t(). Buttons are the highest-impact i18n surface.
